[Unit]
Description=Five-action switching XGBoost and NN (persistent recovery)
StartLimitIntervalSec=0
ConditionPathExists=!/data/workspace/robot_delivery/dynamic-delivery-robot-fleet/runs/icaps_small_city_switching_top5_no_full_mle_v1_20261029/FULL_DEVELOPMENT_COMPLETE.json

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/data/workspace/robot_delivery/dynamic-delivery-robot-fleet/runs/icaps_small_city_switching_top5_no_full_mle_v1_20261029
ExecStart=/data/workspace/robot_delivery/dynamic-delivery-robot-fleet/.venv/bin/python -B -u /data/workspace/robot_delivery/dynamic-delivery-robot-fleet/runs/icaps_small_city_switching_top5_no_full_mle_v1_20261029/operations/run_switching_top5_no_full_mle.py --execute --expected-source-sha256 1bc632436a200bb661d41942d95ed029d8150c729576b72953f13c97de0847c4
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=30s
RuntimeMaxSec=infinity
TimeoutStopSec=45s
KillMode=control-group
MemoryAccounting=yes
Environment=PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
